201)༄༅/rdzun ris chu zla'i zlos gar zhes byas ba rmi lam nying 'khrul gyi bkod pa brjod pa'i yi ge sna tshogs rang grol gyi rnam thar kha skong lags/202)

tei:div.tei:p: 201)༄༅/ rdzun ris chu zla'i zlos gar zhes byas ba rmi lam nying 'khrul gyi bkod pa brjod pa'i yi ge sna tshogs rang grol gyi rnam thar kha skong lags/ 202)na maḥ.ut+tā re bh+yaḥ bdag snyigs dus kyi btsun pa snyoms las pa// gnas ngo mtshar dpal gyi rgod tshang phug /pha bla ma mkha' 'gros byin brlabs par// dus re shig dben pa bstan pa'i tshe// yongs rta lo rgyal zla'i tshes bcu dgu// dgung tho rangs gnyid kyi 'khrul nyams su/ gzugs mi mthong bud med skad snyan pa// grwa bsdebs pa'i glu dbyangs 'dir ltar thos// gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang nas// chos sku snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs// ston pa chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// shar ri bo ta la'i gnas mchog na// 'phags pa thugs rje chen po 203)bzhugs// longs sku spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas// o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs// bla ma sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas mchog gtsang po mgo dgu na// bzhugs sa legs la bzhugs snying spro// bzhugs sa shar la dgon pa nub// drin can bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes de skad zer 'phror gnyid las sad// rang rlung sems 'khrul snang 'char sgo la// don bden pa'i snying po ma mchis na'ang*// tshig sku gsum bla mar phyag 'tshal ba// yid mtshar snyam yi ger bris pa lags// ༈ 204)yang lan cig 'khrul pa'i rmi lam na// na mnyam pa'i btsun ma chas bzang lnga// mi kho bor gus pa'i rnam 'gyur bcas// gtam gleng mo mang zhig bgyis pa'i mthar// zab don gyi chos 'brel dgos so skad// bdag dam chos 'chad do snyam pa'i tshe// chas nor bu'i rigs byed ya mtshan can// sna mang po so sos bdag gi lag /dus gcig tu gtad pa rang nyid kyis// gral rim pa bzhin du blang snyam che// khong dbus ma de yi lag nyid nas// snod thod pa yid 'ong gcig gi nang*// nas dkar mo 'bru yis bkang ba'i steng*// ting 'dra ba'i rin chen snod gcig tu// shel dkar po dri med sgo nga tsam// snod gcig ni dza gad bdud rtsis bkang*// gzhan ngo mtshar 'ga' yang 'dug snyam byed// kun lhan cig bdag gis blangs pa'i mod// gnyis sad cing spro ba'i yid snang ni// yun ring zhig byung

chu mo lug lo/ ) 'bring yar gyi tshes bzang gi /dgung nub gcig rmi lam 'dres pa'i skabs// bdag 'dug pa'i sgom khang mdun nyid du// mgo dung ltar dkar ba'i rgan mo ni// ras dkar po'i phyam rtse gyon pa zhig /phyag 'tshal rjes pus btsug 'dug nas kyang*// lag thal sbyar bdag la 'di skad zer// gnas mchog 'di ru 'dug pa shin tu legs/ sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas su 'di rang bzang*// khyed la gzhan gyis cir mthong cir ma mthong*// ngas ni 'od kyi mchod rten dkar po mthong*// zhes zer nas gar song cha med par// gyur 'di yang mtshar snyam yi ger bris// sngon thog med dus nas 'khor bar 'khyams// las nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i bag chags la// nyin mtshan med rtag tu 'byams pa'i tshul// lar yi ger bris pas mi lang zhing*// des 206)dgos ched yod pa'ang yin mod kyang*// gnas mi min dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i tshogs// dus rtag tu sprin ltar 'du ba'i sa// de'i rnam 'phrul tshul dag yin nam zhes// rang nyid kyis rang la 'di dag gleng*// phyis brjed par dogs nas yi ger btab// gzhan bslu byed zol brdzun ma lags pas// thugs mkhyen ldan rnams kyis mi 'khrel zhu// skyabs bla ma mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs// ༈ e ma hoḥ rgyal ba mchog gis chos rnams kun// rmi lam ji bzhin sgyu ma bzhin/ mi bden bslu ba'i rang bzhin du// nan gyis gsungs kyang rmi lam la// bden 'dzin zhen pas yi ge ru// 'god pa'i ngal ba don med 'di// rang cag blun po'i ngang tshul lags// gnam lo me pho khyi yi 'jug /ka rti ka yi nya ba'i tshe// sked phug brag gi bya skyibs su// nyal ba'i tho rangs rmi lam na// spang ri lho ru kha bltas 207)pa// ljon shing thar thor skyes pa'i khrod// gtsug lag khang pa yid 'ong shing*// sgo 'khyams ri mo bkra ba'i mdun// nyi 'od gsal bar bdag 'dug tshe// zhub chen skyes bu mang po dag

/ba dan gsar pa'i mdung ring ni// lag tu thogs dang gzhogs su bskrun// gos rgyan cha lugs rab bzang ba// mang pos phyogs de gang bar mthong*// de la bdag gis 'di skad smras// khyed cag su yin gang nas 'ongs// 'di ru ci byed gar 'gro dris// de dag nang nas gcig 'ongs te// bdag la 'di skad zer ba thos// bdag cag rgyal ba'i bstan skyong ba'i/ gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu yin// khyed kyi shes par ma gyur tam// gang nas 'ongs dang gar 'gro ba'i// a 'thas bdag cag rnams la med// gnas 'dir gtsug lag khang 'di bsrungs// ston pa'i 208)bstan dang gtsug lag ni// gar yod bdag cag yod pa lags// zer bas slar yang bdag gis dris// 'o na gcang ris bdun cu ni// lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad dang*// rgyu skar nyer brgyad phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi dang 'jigs byed dgu// rigs dang kha dog cha lugs kyi// rnam 'gyur tha dad yod par grags// khyed la de ltar mi snang smras// skyes bu de ni 'dzum zhing rgod// he he khyed kyis mthong tshul du// nged cag 'di ltar snang gyur mod// 'khor 'das snang srid rang snang yin// gcig dang du ma'i tha snyad bral// bdag cag sgyu 'phrul gzugs brnyan la// nges med cir yang ston byed na// khyed kyis mthong tshul gcig pu ru// a 'thas nges bzung ga la 'ongs// nged cag gzugs dang kha dog rigs// gcig dang tha dad rdzu 'phrul gyi// bkod pa gang la gang 'dod yod// de skad zer tshe bdag yed la// a ye shin 209)tu nges par bden// cir snang sems kyi rnam rol la// a 'thas kho nar 'dzin pa bdag /blun las ches blun rang gi skyon// 'on kyang 'di ni rmi lam ste// bdag gi rtsa rlung yid kyis 'khrul// mthong sa mthong mkhan gcig pa la// so sor snang 'di a re mtshar// des na 'ga' zhig dri'o snyam// slar yang 'di ltar dri ba byas// ding sang bskal pa'i babs tshul dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dar nub sogs// 'di ltar gyur pas bdag yid skyo// da dung ci 'drar 'gyur ba lags// bdag kyang bsam pa bzang po yis// ci nus bstan 'gro'i don kho nar// 'bad snyam yod kyang 'khos chungs pas// phan thogs grub pa dka' bar gda'// tshe la'ang nges pa ma mchis tshe// myur du 'chi bar mi 'gyur ram// gal te tshe mthar phyin pa na// chos kyis gzhan la phan nus sam// bar chad sel ba'i thabs la sogs// gang yin

210)bdag la smra bar gyis// de skad byas pas kho na re// bskal pa'i 'pho 'gyur 'di bzhin ni// 'dus byas chos nyid ngang tshul yin// bstan pa'i dar rgud bstan 'dzin rnams// bya byed nyes pa'i 'bras bu nyid// shākya'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyi// cha lugs nyid kyis bsnubs 'gyur ba// lung du bstan pa ma thos sam// bdag cag bstan pa bsrung rnams kyang*// bsrung yul med tshe bsrung thabs bral// da dung rim gyis ngan ngan du// 'gro 'gyur sems can las dbang yin// khyod kyang dam chos 'chad nyan gyi// gzhan phan bsam pa bzang na yang*// khyi la rtswa yi sbyin pa'am// 'on pa'i khrod du glu len 'dra// tshe yi tshad la 'khyol ba yang*// dam sel grib kyis dka' bar mchis// sku tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrig 'dod na// gnas bzang dus tshes bzang po la// rdo rje rgya gram zur rnams su// nor bus spras pa'i gdan bshams nas/ 211)/pak+ṣi war+ṇa ku ma ris// ga ṇā tsakra'i pū dzar bcas// gsol 'debs smon lam mang bgyis na// tshe la phan par 'gyur na yang*// snyigs dus rmu rgod log lta yi// dug gis smyos pa'i skye bo rnams// phyis phyir log par lta ba 'phel// de yis nam yang 'grub par dka'// de skad zer ba'i mod nyid la// gnyid las sad par gyur pa na// sems kyi cho 'phrul sems nyid kyis// mthong ba'i 'khrul pa'i rdzun ris 'di// de de bzhin no bden no zhes// rang gi rang la yi rangs so// ༈ yang ni dpal gyi rnam thos ri// 'pho 'chugs gyur dang dus mtshungs par// nub gcig nying 'khrul rmi lam du// kong po'i cha byad mi dpon gzugs// mgul du rdo rje rtse lnga btags// bag dro snum brjid chags pa zhig /'khor g.yog gnyis bcas bdag drung 'ongs// phyag btsal gus pa'i rnam 'gyur byed// de la bdag gis gtam dris pa// yon 212)bdag khyed cag gang yin smras// nga ngo khyed kyis mi shes sam// dge bsnyen badz+ra sā dhu yin// bdag cag rten yul ma mchis pas// khyed kyi nye skor 'di shed cig

/nged kyi sdod sa zhu 'o zer// yang ni bdag gis slar smras pa// khyed cag bstan srung drag rtsal can// mched 'khor sum brgya drug cur bcas// mthu stobs nus pa bsam yas shing*// thogs med rdzu 'phrul yod bzhin du// gnas dang rten yul ma rnyed pa// de 'dra mi srid ji ltar yin// 'jig rten khams la dbang bsgyur zhing*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung nus na// khyed la de 'dra'i nyams nyes pa// mchis na bstan pa ji ltar bsrung*// de skad smras pas kho na re// bdag cag mi min lha 'dre rnams// zag bcas rdzu 'phrul nus rtsal sogs// yod kyang gnas skabs rkyen dbang btsan// zag med gtan srid ma zin skyon// bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer lji yang*// bstan 'dzin 213)rnams kyi spyod la rag /tshul bzhin spyod na bstan pa yin// tshul min spyod na bdag cag kyang*// bsrung skyob bya ba'i yul min la// byas na rgyal ba'i dam dang 'gal// de phyir dka' bar byung ngo zer// 'o na bdag gi bstan pa dang*// dam chos ma gtogs bsam rgyu med// 'on kyang thos sgom bsam gsum gyi// nus stobs zhan tshe rlabs cher dka'// gang nus 'khos la dpags pa yis// gzhan phan lhag bsam ma gtogs pa// nor dang khe grags la 'dod min// yin min khyed rnams gzigs mod kyi// bsam pa thog tu 'khel lam dris// kho nyid mgo bo yon yon byas// khyed rang bsam pa dkar lags kyang*// bstan 'gro'i bsod nams thur du bri// dam chos tshe gcig sangs rgyas las// chang phor gang nyid 'dams mkhan mang*// 'chad nyan thob lo zhu lo tsam// nyams len gnad bsnun su yang med// dam nyams 'dus pa'i 214)chos 'khor de// bsam pa dkar yang 'bras bu nag /dam sel grib skyon bar chad mang*// grwa tshogs rnams kyis chang khrims mna'// mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpang btsugs nas// nyams pa'i grib kyis khyed kyi tshe// lo bzhi bstungs pa ma go'am// des na spyir gyi zab chos dang*/

khyad par dgongs 'dus la sogs pa// zer 'phror bdag ni gnyid sad de// kho yi tshig mjug rdzogs ma byung*// rang sems rtsa rlung 'khrugs pa yi// rnam rtog bag chags nying 'khrul la/ bden pa'i snying po ma mchis kyang*// dngos kyi tshul dang rmi lam 'di// rtags mthun snang phyir mtshar snyam nas// yi ger bris 'di zog brdzun du// mthong dogs sbas na legs snyam lags/ ༈ kun rdzob snang ngor srung ma 'di dag kyang*// gsol mchod rten na 'go bar 'gyur srid de// skyabs gnas snying por dkon mchog bla ma chog 'khrul gzugs lha 'dre'i grogs kyis 215)ci zhig bya// ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang du bskyur nas bsdad// rtag tu gsol mchod byas kyang mi mgu la// nub gcig chag na'ang 'khang zhing 'khu ba yi// srung ma de 'drar re blo bdag la med// skyid sdug thams cad bla ma'i drin du phaṭaḥ e ma/ skyabs gnas bla ma rang rig dbyer med la// 'du 'bral med par rtogs pas phyag byas nas// yang cig snyigs mtha'i ban chung snyoms las pa// sna tshogs rang grol rgan po 'brug gi lor/ chu stod zla ba'i nyer bdun mtshan mo'i gung*// gti mug gnyid du nyal ba'i 'khrul snang la// rmi lam bar do'i 'char tshul bshad kyi nyon// nub tu kha blta'i lung pa gcong rong zab// 'jigs rung chu bo rba klong 'khrug pa'i 'gram// rdo dang tsher mas gtams pa'i lam 'phrang du// gshed ma'i skyes bu mi lus stag mgo can// mi tshad nyis 216)'gyur tsam gyi gzugs ldan pa// de dang 'dra la gshin rje'am khro bo'i gdong*// rngams pa gcig dang bcas pas bdag 'khrid nas// nyi nub sa sros nub tu rgyugs cing ded// grogs ni ra lug ba lang 'ga' zhig snang*// rlung nag thal 'tshub gnam sa g.yo ba tsam// rdo yi char pa sgong dang khu tshur dang*// kham bu tsam sogs ser drag 'bab ltar brdung*// chu glung sgra yi seb nas ngar skad kyis// chos med ban btsun dkor zan bla gzugs tsho// skyid po yod min 'di ru blta'o zer// bar skabs gcig na chu chen 'gram 'di ru// ka pā la 'dra'i mtsho chen kham nag 'khrug

/kha zheng mda' rgyang ring shos tshad tsam zhig /khol khol long long 'dug pa'i bar dag du// ban de'am sham thabs rkang pa lhug tsam mthong*// res 'ga' mgo dang la pa rib rib khol// de yi 'gram du sleb ma thag nyid la// gshed ma 217)gnyis des bdag gi lag re bzung*// mtsho 'di khyed tsho'i sdod sa yin pas na// khyed rang mchong ngam nged kyis bskyur ram zer// de tshe bdag gi 'di ltar dran cing smras// dge sdig rgyu 'bras las la bslu ba med// skyes mtha' 'chi dang shi nas bar dor 'khyams// sdig can dmyal bar 'tshod pa shin tu bden// 'di 'dra yong ba go yang go nas yod// 'on kyang bdag la 'chi kha'i thim rim tsam// shes 'ongs snyam yang ma tshor shi nas snang*// drin can rje btsun gzhan phan rdo rje la// rdzogs chen yang ti'i nyams khrid zhus pa'i skabs// bar do rjes ma lhun grub rin po cher// grol bar 'gyur ba'i bka' lung byung na yang*// rnam g.yeng skyon dang dkor gy-i sgribs pas lan// nyams len byas pa'i gdeng tshad med na yang*// bu chung nas bzung da lta'i bar nyid du// sdig la 218)'bag ma myong ba'i blo gdengs yod// mi tshe hril por blo kha chos la sgrim// 'gyod pa'i bsam pa spu tsam bdag la med// grwa 'khor skyong phyir bla gzugs bzung ba des// dad rdzas dkor zas 'dam du chud pa yi// rnam smin 'bras bu da lta 'di ru smin// snyigs dus bla ma'i gzugs brnyan bdag 'dra rnams// rang ma smin par gzhan gyi 'dren pa byed// shi nas 'gro sa de 'dra los kyang bden// 'on kyang 'khor 'das sems kyi rnam rol yin// bde ba can nas mnar med dmyal ba'i bar// gang snang gang shar rang rig chos kyi sku'i// 'char tshul tsam las don la dbyer med nyid// 'di las 'bum 'gyur 'jigs pa'i dmyal ba ru// skyes kyang chos sku 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang*// rig pa gcer bu bzo med 'di ka'i thog

/the tshom rdul tsam med par kho thag chod// des na bdag la 'brel pa thog 219)med kyis// gtso byas nam mkhas gar khyab sems can tshogs// sdig pa'i rnam smin dmyalabar ltung 'gyur las// thams cad ma lus bdag la smin gyur cig /'gro kun ngan song sdug bsngal bral bar shog /de skad smras nas mtsho der mchong snyam pas// gshed ma de gnyis bzhad gang chen po bgad// bdag gi lag bzung mchong du ma bcug par// stag mgo can des slar yang 'di skad zer// kha chos mkhas la lag len mi dge 'bad// chos brgyad tshe 'di 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa yi// bla ma'i tshul dang chos par brloms pa rnams// 'gro sa 'dug sa 'di nyid yin na'ang*// khyed la 'di yi rgyus rnams che 'dug cing*// sems bskyed smon lam snying nas thag chod kyi// gdengs tshad de 'drar dmyal ba ga nas 'ongs// da dung smon lam 'di 'dra rgyun du mdzod// da ni nam mkhar rdo rje'i gar mdzod cig /zer bas bdag nyid 220)bar snang khams su 'phags// chos tshig shugs 'byung mang po glu len cing*/ pad skor gar stabs mang po byas pa'i 'phror// gnyis las sad cing lus po 'dar yod 'dug /'di 'dra'i rmi lam sngon chad rmis ma myong*// mtshar snyam yi ge'i lam du bkod lags kyang*// dus mtha'i 'gro ba log lta che ba'i mthus// gzhan yid khong khro'i zug rngu mi ldang shog /tshul 'di dad ldan 'ga' la phan srid na// thams cad blo kha chos la 'gyur ba shog ༈ yang ni lcags mo glang lo cho 'phrul zla'i// dus chen tshes pa bco lnga'i nub mo ru// dge slong sgrigs ma thams cad tshar ba'i mthar// slar yang ltos bcas 'brel thogs mkha' khyab kyi// 'gro la dmigs nas sgyu lus mchod sbyin dang*// bzang spyod la sogs smon lam mang po bton// nam phyed ma song bar du bsdad pa'i rjes/ gnyid du nyal ba'i rmi lam nying 'khrul la/ sngar nas 221)shi ba'i rang gi grwa rgan rigs// grong chog mang du 'gro mkhan 'ga' re dang*// gnyer byed las 'dzin shi ba 'ga' dang bcas// lhan cig mi dga' bzhin du dbang med phyin// sha zan rong yin zer ba'i lung pa ni// ri rong dog cing mun nag 'thib pa yi// nub nas shar du kha ltas ri gzar po// rtsi shing la sogs gang yang ma skyes shing*// sa kun khrag gi 'dam rdzab nang khrol dang*// rgyu lto ljan ljin mang pos khyab pa'i ngogs// gzar mo'i thur der 'dred rung 'gyel rung phyin// rwa gzhob 'dra ba'i dri ma ngan pa 'tshubs// rkang pa thams cad khrag gis 'dam gyis g.yogs// skyug kyang bro la sa ngang bzhin du ni// mkhar ba gtsugs te dka' las chen pos phyin// bar mtshams shig tu grong khyer chen po ni// zhig pa'i shul gyi khang hrul grangs med snang*// bdag gi zla bo de dag la la ni/

222) /khang hrul bug pa'i nang du 'jul te song*// bdag kyang lam ngan 'di 'drar 'gro ba las// khong tsho'i phyi la byin pa drag gam snyam// brdzangs pas khong tsho 'dzul sar nga ma shong// yang ni sngar gyi thur lam 'phro der phyin// mar mar sleb bzhin mun pa nag tu song*// sdong skas gzar mo thog so gsum tshad tsam// de mgor sleb tshe shin tu kha nag pas// ma mthong sbar 'jus byas nas babs pa'i dus// rang gi mgo 'di rab tu ljing ba 'dras// yor ma thub par mgo mjug log la khad// skas la dam du bzung zhing babs pa'i thil// khang khog chen po lud dang 'dam rdzab can// dri mi zhim zhing khang nag gcig tu sleb// khyi gu'am ni a li phru gu'i skad// 'dra la mi snyan tsi dir mang po sbir// de yi bar khang zhig tu phyin pa yis// ngo mi shes pa'i gcan gzan phru gu ni// mang pos bdag 223)la rub nas 'brad du byung*// ber ka g.yug cing rgol yang ma thub par// bdag gi lag pa g.yon la gcig gis rmugs// ber ka rgyab pas de ni sa la lhung*// lci ba'i phung po gcig tu gyur nas snang*// lag pa'i mthil gyi rma la bltas tsa na// lcags kyi sder mo kha gsum rnon po zhig /zugs nas gda' bas nan gyis bkog nas der// mi skya gnyis 'dug gcig gi pang par bskyur/ ༈ khyed kyi khyi'am gcan gzan 'di rnams kyis// nga la 'di ltar rmugs byung smras pa'i tshe// mi skya de yis bdag la 'di skad zer/ ༈ 'di ni sha zan srog gi spu gri yin// khyed cag ban btsun rnams la lhag par sdang*// khyed la lag par zug pa g.yas chung yin// gzhan ni glad rgya'am snying rtsa nag po la// zug nas thon pa'i go skabs med pas na// de 'drar ma zug kha rje 224)khyed re che/ ༈ /de skad zer 'phror steng thog zhig tu sleb// rang gi nye gnas bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis// tshod ma 'dra ba de las ser tsam pa// thur ma gang zhig bdag gi lag tu blug

/'di ni rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byas pa yi// dngos grub rdzas kyi skal ba yin no zer// zos pas sngar ma myong ba'i ro mchog tshor// de yi lhag ma lag tu 'gos 'dus pa// sngar gyi rma der byugs shing bsdad pa'i tshe// rab byung cha byad mdog nag bzhin mi sdug /gos chen ljang nag las grub snam sbyar gyon// bong tshad khang pa nyis thog tsam yod pa// 'jigs su rung ba gcig gi 'khor du yang*// ban rgan ham phrog mi tshad sum 'gyur tsam// chos gos gyon zhing yid du mi 'ong ba'i/ rnam 'gyur can dang gzhan yang mi nag ni// lpags gos gyon zhing 'brog pa'i rigs 'dra ba// lag tu zhags thag nag po 'ba' zhig 225)thogs// de 'dra'i dpon g.yog mang pos bdag la bskor// gtso bo de yis 'di skad zer ba thos// khyod 'dir dal bar 'dug pa rdzab re che// ban+dhe'i gshed mar ban n+dhe sleb yod do// legs nyes 'byed pa'i khrims bdag nga yin no// ding sang khyed cag bla ma mkhan slob dang*// dge 'dun ming btags chos pa'i gzugs bzung nas// shi gson kun gyi skyabs yul byed mkhan tsho// pha mar gyur pa'i sems can srog bcad pa'i// sha la lto yi dam pa byed nus pa// snying stobs 'di 'dra'i chos lugs a la la// glau ba khrag gis rgyangs pa'i zhim sha dang*// mchin pa 'khyags su bor ba'i mtshar zas dang*// gson khrag tshod mar byas pa'i bzhes spro sogs// khyed cag btsun pa rnams kyis za lugs la// sha khrag zas la gcan zan las kyang haṃ// chang rag 'thung 226)la sbur gog las kyang sred// dkor zas 'tshol la yi dwags las kyang mug /da rung dge slong yin par khas len nam// lhung bzed thogs nas sha khrag za lugs dang*// chos gos sham thabs chang gi bang lugs dang*// tshong khe nor rdzas bud med tshol lugs 'di// dkon mchog gsum la ngo yang mi tsha'am// sbyin bdag rnams kyi dkor la za dus dang*// sha za chang 'thung byed pa'i skyid po de// las kyi khrims ra 'di na sleb dus su// skyid sdug ci 'dug ltos dang dkor zan tsho// ma gi sha za nag po'i btson khang na// khyed rang rnams kyis sha yi za tshul dang*// byed lugs mthun pa'i bkod pa tha dad du// khyed rang btsun pa tsho la byed cing yod// la la btsabs yod la la brdung zhing yod// la la btso zhing la la 'khyag la bor// la la khram nyag tshwa blug bsreg yod do// khyod kyang 'gro ran da lta 'dong zhig zer/

227)/bdag ni rmi lam yin par dran ma thub// 'jigs kyang 'jigs la skyo yang rab tu skyo// mchi ma 'khrug bzhin lan du 'di smras so/ ༈ bden no bden no ci gsung shin tu bden// nged cag dus ngan snyigs ma'i btsun gzugs rnams// mi skya las kyang lod pa'i spyod yul la// khrims kyi chad pas gcod pa thugs bden mod// bdag gi ngos nas rgyu mtshan ci zhu na// byis pa'i dus nas bag chags bzang ba'i rgyus// gzhan ltar sdig pa'i dri mas gos ma myong*// khyad par sha khrag dmar la zhen pa log /sdig zas khong du song ba nyung shos yin// dkar dang 'bru 'bras go ma la nyung dang*// sha mo tshod ma skyo tsha'i 'tsho ba yis// mi tshe 'di tsam bar du bskyal pa las// sha chang zas la bsten pa'i mi gcig min// bzang ja rin thang can rnams 'thung mang ba'i// dkor sgrib 228)nyes pa che bar yod shas che// gzhan ni nyes ltung phog pa'i skyon can zhig /yong ba'i rgyu rkyen bdag la yod snyam med// bsam pa rnyed cing go rtogs 'jags tshun nas// bza' btung gdan gos nyer spyad mtha' dag la// 'du shes gsum sogs skyed rdzogs gang rung gi /gnad kyis tha mal longs su spyod ma myong*// thos bsam sgom pa'i gdeng tshad med na'ang*// drin can bla ma bco brgyad zhabs la zin// kun gyis dgongs pa'i rtse gtad thugs rjes bskyangs// dam tshig nyams chag dri mas gos snyam med// na so cher song dam bca' mang du gtong*// dka' spyad snying rus dge sbyor gong du spar// 'chi dus mi 'gyod tsam zhig e yong bsam// khyed kyi khrims bcad mdzad na'ang gang 'os mdzod// khyad par sha chang bag med spyod pa ni// rang yang ma byas gzhan la'ang zhen pa chad// me lo bya lo sa 229)ga'i dus chen nas// bzung ste mi tshe 'di la gar sdod kyang*// phabs kyis btab pa'i rigs gyur dri tsam yang*// phyogs su mi nye thag chod dam bca' ni// bdag cag dpon slob gsum kas lhan cig byas// tshes bcu'i mchod pa bdud rtsi sman raka kyang*// gtsang ma'i chu la ka ra bu ram sbyangs// rgyud nas gsungs

rtsa brgyad stong sbyar dang rak+ta sum cu rtsa lnga pa'i/ mchan/ }pa'i bdud rtsi'i ril bu nyid// tshul ldan sbyar nas btab pa ma gtogs pa// chang gi dri ma rlung phyogs tsam yang med// chang 'thung mkhan dang tshe 'dir mi 'grogs cing*// tshe rabs gzhan du'ang rab byung sha chang la// bag med spyod pa'i yul phyogs mi skye bar// smon lam snying khong rus pa'i dkyil nas 'debs// sha chang med pa'i rkyen gyi shi na yang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa'ang rdzogs 'gyur zhing*// chos pa'i nang nas yang rtser 230)'gyur ro snyam// bdag gi blo phug gtad tshul don chen yin// gang ltar khyed rnams dge sdig shan 'byed kyi// khrims bdag yin na las kyi me long dang*// rtsis kyi khram shing shā+o rdel dkar nag sogs// gsal bar yod 'ong bdag 'dras bshad ci dgos// nga rang sems la g.yo sgyu zol zog dang*// bag sgrib spu tsam med par rgyu mtshan kun// zhus 'dir ci 'thad gang 'os khyed kyis mdzod// 'bros pas mi thar gzur bas ga la thub// nga yi gdos bcas sgyu lus gog po 'di// khyod kyis btso sreg bcad btub ci byas kun// bdag gis las sgrib rang snang ma gtogs pa// rang rig chos sku'i don la 'pho 'gyur med// de skad smras pas khong rnams 'dzum mdangs ston// 'o 'o de yin bden no shin tu legs// da rung de ltar gyis shig zer ba'i skad// dpon g.yog tshang mas sbir gyi grag pa dang*// nga rang gnyid las sad 231)pa dus mnyam byung*// 'khrul pa'i 'char sgo rmi lam 'di 'dra la// gzhan dag yid ches byed mkhan mi 'byung bas// rang nyid bsam bzhin mchi ma dbang med shor// skyo shas snying nas skyes te dran thor bris// kye ma rmi lam tsam na 'di 'dra na// shi dus 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal ci tsam yod// mi 'gyod tsam gyi rtog gtad da lta nas// rang mgo bsgrim ran min nam grogs po bdag

/e ma ho/ bdag 'dra dus mthar skyes pa yis// mi rgan sna tshogs rang grol gyis// rangalo lnga bcu rtsa lnga par// rgya la rtsa rdum gangs kyi mgul// byang chub spang gi yang rtse ni// shin tu ma tho zhing dben pa'i khrod// zla gsum gnyan pa gcod du phyin// dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes kyi// tho reng rmi lam za zi la// gzugs ni ha cang mi gsal ba'i// skad kyi bdag la 'di ltar zer// 'di 232)na 'dab chags gu ling ma// spun bzhi yod pa 'di rnams kyis// bla na med pa'i byang chub tu// sems bskyed zhus pa yin lags pas// khyed kyi 'di dag so so la/ ming re 'dogs par zhu'o zer// de la bdag gis 'di skad smras// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa// de ni shin tu ngo mtshar che// khyed cag dud 'gro'i skye gnas su// gyur yang byang chub blo yod pa// legs so ya mtshan che lags kyi// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed na// tshad med bzhi po med thabs med// de phyir gu ling spun bzhi la// ming yang 'di bzhin gdags par bgyi// dang po de la byams pa sgron// gnyis pa la ni snying rje skyid// gsum pa de la dga' ba 'tsho// bzhi par btang snyoms dpal mor thogs// de skad smras ma thag nyid du// gnyid las sad dang dus mnyam par// rang gi rgyab kyi ri logs de'i// nye sar gu ling skad mang po// bsgrags 233)nas shar ri'i phyogs su song*// rmi lam 'di yang g.yas chung kyang*// gnas dang rten 'brel bzang snyam nas/ brjed thor bris dges 'gro ba kun// byang chub lam la 'jug gyur cig dge'o// 234)
